results.title: Clarity Systems Closes Seed Round Led by LMnT Ventures to Tackle Returns Fraud | FinancialContent
highlights:
Clarity Systems, a retail fraud detection company, today announced the close of a $4.4 million seed round backed by LMnT Ventures, with participation from Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures. The Company’s system sees inside returned and received products in three seconds without having to manually open them - catching counterfeits, product swaps, and manipulation by comparing items or potential fraudulent items against the original manufacturer profile.

Clarity Systems has raised $4.4 million in seed funding to scale its AI-powered fraud detection technology, which can inspect returned and received products in three seconds without requiring retailers to open the packaging. The round was led by LMnT Ventures, with participation from Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures.

results.title: IBM Acquires Clarity Systems
results.author: IBM
highlights: ARMONK, N.Y., Oct. 21 /PRNewswire-FirstCall/ -- IBM (NYSE: IBM) today acquired Clarity Systems, a privately-held company based in Toronto, Canada. Financial terms were not disclosed.
